Latest Activity.note: The German energy industry association BDEW published a list of power plants in planning or construction on 1 April 2019. It lists a 570 MW gas plant at the Leverkusen chemical park under STEAG, with the status that it was in the permit procedure. This is the newest dated report of activity I found. The same list is where GEM's note about a 2019 mention most likely comes from.

units.notes: I found no document that says the project was dropped or that a permit was refused. The only later evidence is the April 2019 list, and nothing newer mentions the project. A May 2015 trade press article says STEAG bought the project rights from Repower and had not yet decided to build.
